# Goangseup Zi

![Goangseup Zi](profile.jpg){width=220}

I am a professor of structural engineering and mechanics at Korea University.

My research and teaching interests include structural engineering & mechanics, offshore
wind structures, digital transformations, computational mechanics, fracture mechanics, and engineering education.

This blog is intended to explain engineering research and mechanics in a form that is useful to researchers, practicing
engineers, and students.

## Author

**Goangseup Zi**
Also published as **G. Zi**
